newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-HILL COMPLETES JUST ONE LAP IN NEW CAR.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-HILL COMPLETES JUST ONE LAP IN NEW CAR.

text.p: World champion Damon Hill managed just one lap when he tested his new Arrows car on Friday.

The Arrows-A18 Formula One car had been due to arrive at the Northamptonshire track in the morning for a day-long test but a gearbox software problem had delayed its arrival from the team's factory and it did not turn up until mid afternoon.
It then took one hour for the team to set up the car before Hill set off on one circuit before darkness fell.
But Hill was far from downhearted by the brevity of the testing.

"We ran one lap and I am delighted with that," he said. "The team have been working extremely hard and they were prepared to run the car until it was absolutely ready, even though by then it was too dark to run properly.
"It is vital to do a shakedown before serious testing...at least now we know the car is up and running."

Team boss Tom Walkinshaw was equally delighted with the brief outing of the Yamaha-powered machine and believes it will give his team a psychological boost as they head for three days' testing in Jerez.
"We just wanted to make sure the wheels turned before it was sent to Spain," he said.
